final: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL)/SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(r.cnt) AS avg_track_count, AVG(r.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_excess FROM r, a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate
